title: Whole Open Chuck and Flaring Preparation Bay
description: One complete static pipe-tool preparation bay, one scene and zero new models. The entire original through-chuck and raised-head machine stands on the left on all four original feet, with its longitudinal guides and elevated annular head facing the open central interval. A whole perpendicular open worktable on the right supports the complete split-bar and yoke flaring tool at unit scale on its real tabletop. The machine remains an independent floor station and the small hand-tool station is raised and separate, rather than three metal-forming stations or two opposed office processing benches. All original raw GLB buffers, meshes, local normals, per-face opaque PBR and internal hierarchy are unchanged; only exact whole-instance quarter-turns/translations and one finite scene-only floor are new. No pipe or workpiece, connected processing line, thread geometry, powered action, clamping, flow, access certification or machinery safety claim. Rigging animation interaction not made.
